$comment: THE SEVEN CANONICAL e2e FAILURES. A suite run containing EXACTLY these is a pass;
one containing more, fewer, or the same tests failing for a different reason is a
fail. Consumed by tools/check-suite-signatures.cjs.
IDENTITY IS `file` + `titlePath`, NOT LINE NUMBERS. Line numbers decay on every
edit above them; the `baselineRef` field below carries the file:line form purely
so an entry can be matched against the suite-baseline drawer by eye.
REASON CLASSES, NEVER PIXEL COUNTS. apexcharts has measured 3,126 / 3,341 / 3,261
/ 3,285 / 3,384 differing pixels across five rounds; an exact-count assertion
would be permanently red.
AUTHORITY for the seven and their signatures: MemPalace drawer
drawer_havdm_testing_127a89e2ddcdeb101452523a (HAVDM suite baseline + failure
signatures + flake ledger). NOTHING HERE IS A LICENCE TO RE-BASELINE: retiring an
entry needs a cause and the owner's authorisation.
`reasonClassVerified` records whether the class was read from an actual Playwright
JSON report in this repository, or inferred from the drawer's prose description.
The first green visual CI run is what converts the `false` entries.

⭐ 2026-08-14: the visual tier was MEASURED on ubuntu-latest (run 31802864528). 12 of 19 passed against the WSL2-generated -linux baselines, 1 skipped, and the 6 failures were EXACTLY this manifest's visual set, reason classes included. GitHub's Ubuntu therefore renders like the maintainer's WSL2+Xvfb box for these snapshots, and NO Docker image is required. Nothing was re-baselined to achieve this.
⚠⚠ 2026-08-15, AFTER CODEX ROUND-1 FINDINGS M1 AND M2. This manifest previously
held ONLY expectedFailures, and the gate counted SKIPPED tests toward its size
floor. Measured: a report with 560 of 561 outcomes skipped exited 0, and a newly
flaky regression exited 0. A floor over IDENTITIES is not evidence of EXECUTION.
Two more baselines now exist and the floor counts executed outcomes only.
expectedSkips — read from the real reports of run 31802864528, not typed. A skip
that is not baselined FAILS, and a baselined skip that did not occur FAILS (it
either started running, which is good news needing a manifest update, or its
identity moved).
expectedFlaky — the eight-item watched-flake ledger from drawer
drawer_havdm_testing_127a89e2ddcdeb101452523a, resolved from prose spec:line to
real identities via `--list` on 2026-08-15; all eight resolved. ANY OTHER flaky
identity now FAILS the run. ⚠ THE TWO FLAKES OBSERVED IN RUN 31802864528 ARE
NOT IN THIS LIST AND ARE NOT ADDED HERE — adding them would be re-baselining
without a cause and without the owner's authorisation. They will fail the gate
until adjudicated, which is the intended behaviour.
